Our mission

بَلِّغُوا عَنِّي وَلَوْ آيَةً“Convey from me, even if it is one verse.”Sahih al-Bukhari · 3461

Our aim is simple: that every Muslim — and anyone curious — can read the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ in their own language, from trusted sources, for free.

Authentic

Only well-known Seerah books and checked references. Disputed points are marked as disputed.

Free for everyone

No paywall, no subscription. Knowledge of the Seerah should reach everyone.

Multilingual

Arabic, English, Urdu, Hindi, Nepali, Bangla, Turkish, Indonesian and more — the app and the books follow your language.

Easy to read

A calm reader, offline downloads, quizzes and timelines — made for phones.

What’s next
  • Native Android & iPhone apps
  • Audio for the books
  • More languages and more books
  • A quiz for every chapter

Sources & methodology

Everything in Seerah comes from published books and reports. Here is what we use and how it is checked.

Main books
Ar-Raheeq Al-MakhtumSafiur Rahman Mubarakpuri · 1st prize, Muslim World League
The Messenger of Islam ﷺPrepared by Byenah — in 75 languages
When the Moon SplitSafiur Rahman Mubarakpuri (Rawdat al-Anwar)
Durr-e-Yateem ﷺMahir-ul-Qadri · Urdu
Reference works

Ibn Hisham, al-Sirah al-Nabawiyyah · Sahih al-Bukhari · Sahih Muslim · al-Dhahabi, Siyar A‘lam al-Nubala’ · Ibn Hazm, Jamharat Ansab al-‘Arab · al-Mansurpuri, Rahmatul-lil-‘Alamin. Each page shows its own references.

How content is checked
  1. From the bookText is taken from the published edition, not rewritten.
  2. TranslationTranslated or taken from an existing published translation.
  3. ReviewA second person checks names, dates and references.
  4. PublishedOnly reviewed text is marked as published in the app.
What the marks mean
Established / Agreed — accepted by historiansApproximate — the year is known, the exact date is notDisputed — scholars differ; both views are explained

Privacy & terms

Short version: the Seerah app has no accounts and does not collect your personal data.

Settings stay on your phoneLanguage, theme, text size, reminder time and quiz progress are saved only on this device.
Downloads stay inside the appOffline books are stored privately in the app, for reading inside the app only, and can be removed any time in Downloads.
Book text comes from our databaseThe app reads book content from our server. We do not track what you read.
Forms open WhatsAppJoin us and Support us only open WhatsApp with a message you can see and edit before sending. Nothing is stored in the app.
Links to other appsWhatsApp, Telegram, YouTube and other links follow those services’ own privacy policies.
Terms of use
Free to read and shareYou may read, quote and share content for non-commercial, educational use, with a mention of the book and the Seerah app.
Books belong to their authorsBook texts and translations remain the property of their authors and publishers. Please do not copy or republish whole books.
AccuracyWe check content carefully, but mistakes can happen. Please report any mistake so we can correct it.
ChangesThe app and these terms may be updated. Continued use means you accept the latest version.

Questions? Contact us on WhatsApp.

Seerah

Seerah is a free, source-based library on the life of Prophet Muhammad ﷺ, available in many languages.

It is built by UmmahTech, a team of designers, developers, translators and reviewers working to make authentic Islamic knowledge easy to read for everyone.
